name: Anika Mahbub
bio: Anika was a volunteer research student for the Bronx High School of Science research program. She was mentored by Colby E. Sain for the summer of 2024. She worked in the Molecular Systematics Laboratory learning lab techniques such as DNA extraction and PCR, and helped make a data base of *Vaejovis* morphometrics. She went on to pursue a Bachelors of Science at Brandeis University.
